reason: A DSH adapter that integrates iHow Memory Core to provide local persistent memory and retrieval across agent sessions through MCP tools.

summaries.zh: 将 iHow Memory Core 集成到 DeepSeek Harness，为智能体提供基于本地存储的跨会话记忆与检索工具。
summaries.en: Integrates iHow Memory Core with DeepSeek Harness to provide agents with local persistent memory and retrieval tools across sessions.

capabilities: Provides persistent local memory storage and retrieval across sessions
Integrates memory tools with DSH through an MCP client
Spawns a bundled Core process over stdio
Reads from and writes to configured local memory and state directories
